workflow.critical: Generate all QA documents in {reporting_language} (Arabic by default)
Execute ALL steps in exact order — do NOT skip steps
Save artifacts after EACH phase completes — never batch phases
Never skip a phase even if prior phases produced warnings — collect ALL results
Output base path for all artifacts: {output_folder}/{story_id}/

ALL generated files (E2E tests, test cases, test data, bug reports, reports) MUST be written ONLY inside {output_folder}/{story_id}/ — which resolves to ai-qa-framework/TestResult/{story_id}/. NEVER write to any folder found in the host project such as e2e/, tests/, src/e2e/, src/test/, or similar. Those folders belong to the host project and must NEVER be touched.

step.goal: Resolve story file and suite name

check.action: Use provided story file path directly

check.ask: Please provide the path to the user story file (e.g., _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/1-1-opt-in-link-generation.md): You can also run: /AIQA-FullWorkflow _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/1-1-opt-in-link-generation.md

step.action: Verify project.config.json is written to core/ folder
step.output: ✅ Phase 0 complete — project stack detected and saved to core/project.config.json

step.action: Verify story AST JSON is generated in TestResult/{story_id}/
step.output: ✅ Phase 1 complete — story AST generated with acceptance criteria, scenarios, and risks

step.action: Verify Arabic XLSX and MD files are written to {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/
step.output: ✅ Phase 2 complete — Arabic test cases generated in XLSX and MD formats

step.action: Verify Page Object file and spec file are written to {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/
step.output: ✅ Phase 3 complete — Playwright POM + spec files generated

step.action: Verify JSON test data files are written to {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-data/
step.output: ✅ Phase 4 complete — test data JSON files generated (including edge case and security payloads)

step.action: Browser opens visually in {test_mode} mode using {default_browser}
Capture screenshots, videos, traces, JUnit XML
step.output: ✅ Phase 5 complete — tests executed, artifacts saved

step.action: Triage all test failures and generate Arabic bug reports
step.output: ✅ Phase 6 complete — Arabic bug reports generated with root-cause analysis

step.action: Aggregate all phase results into HTML dashboard + XLSX + MD summary
step.output: ✅ Phase 7 complete — final QA report generated

check.output: ⚠️ Quality gate FAILED — {pass_rate}% < {min_pass_rate}% — review bug reports before release
